sloka: पुनरेव महाबाउर्मया भ्रात्रा च सम्गतः ।अयोध्याम् वनवासात्तु प्रविशत्वनघोऽनघे ॥२-५२-९१॥
transliteration: punareva mahābāurmayā bhrātrā ca samgataḥ ।ayodhyām vanavāsāttu praviśatvanagho'naghe ॥2-52-91॥

translations.english: O sacred one may the blemishless, mightyarmed Rama accompanied by me and his brother reenter Ayodhya after the exile.
